name: duty-revenue-ops
description: Deterministic revenue operations for a Duty instance: recover abandoned carts and deliver the daily revenue brief. No LLM required.

duty_url.description: Base URL of the Duty instance, e.g. https://duty.your-company.com

admin_token_secret.description: Name of the stored secret that holds the Duty ADMIN_TOKEN

min_probability.description: Only chase draft orders whose win probability is at least this

older_than_minutes.description: Only chase carts idle for at least this long

report_email.description: Optional address to email the brief to (needs SMTP_URL on Duty)
